agent_explanation: No controller work (disabled) and one dt step, yet energy jumps 3712->23651J. Bodies start 2.0 apart head-on at closing speed ~58 m/s and end touching (gap -0.0009) after 6 substeps. Heavy body (m=16.6) reverses from vx -16.3 to +45.75 while light body barely slows (42.0->38.3), massively increasing both momentum and kinetic energy. Likely cause: circle-circle impulse applied repeatedly across substeps and/or with positional-correction velocity injection, double-counting the impulse for disparate masses at high closing speed instead of a single momentum-conserving impulse.
